```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```


```{r}

ukhsa <- read.csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(ukhsa))

ggplot(ukhsa, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
) ) +
  geom_line( colour = "red") +
  ylab("Consumption") +
  xlab("Time") +
  ggtitle("Consumption of antibiotics over time")

```
